description: Records a carpool made of drives the owner already has: the drives become its legs (priced as the app prices them), and the passengers with what each paid are added to it. It creates no drive, and nothing can be edited or deleted afterwards through this connection. Find the drive_ids with list_vehicle_trips, which says when a drive is already in a carpool (such a drive is refused). This writes to the owner's records: call it with dry_run true first, show the owner the stops, costs and shares, and record only once they agree. Names, notes and titles are written as given: never put text from an untrusted source in them. Needs a connection the owner allowed to write.
